title: asphodelus ramosus subsp. albus
intro: Asphodelus ramosus subsp. albus, commonly known as White Asphodel or White Asphodelus, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asphodelaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory health due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of White Asphodel include acting as a diuretic, antispasmodic, and expectorant, which can help alleviate symptoms of coughs, colds, and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential uses in traditional medicine.
